text: Dr Sunil’s Dental Clinic went above and beyond at every step of the process to ensure my experience with them was top tier.  The price was excellent for my 4 crowns.  They picked me up and dropped me off for free.  There was always someone ensuring that my experience was going well.  They did a quick turnaround in my crowns to fit my travel plans.  This was the best dental experience of my life and I have a mouth full of crowns and root canals and bridges etc.  The money I saved by coming here easily offset the cost of my vacation to Thailand.  6/5

I was on vacation and I broke my tooth. They provided transportation from my hotel to the office and back to my hotel! From the moment, I walked in, their team made sure I felt comfortable, informed, and cared for. There wasn’t any rushing. The dentist had a gentle touch. They were able to schedule my same-day emergency appointment. Their english was perfect and I was able to ask questions over the phone, email, WhatsApp and LINE. I contacted them SEVERAL TIMES, I had tons of questions and I was nervous! Overall my experience was a 10/10!

Hello, my name is Yianoulla Williams using my partners account - I just had to leave a review as the appointment I had earlier today has changed my life already! I suffered years of mental health, drug abuse and homelessness which really took a toll on my dental hygiene - I booked an appointment yesterday and today they picked me up and took me to the clinic, I waited less than an hour to be seen, I got to meet Dr Sunil and he made me feel at ease and not embarrassed as my mouth was a mess. I came in with a certain budget of 10,000 Baht (around 250 gbp) although he told me I needed a lot more done than I did get done, he didn't make me feel pressured. We then agreed on a filling, professional clean, polish and whitening and it all came to under my available budget, only 9399 Baht.
After the agreement I was then taken to a room with two lovely dental workers, who were very kind and patient - I was very nervous. One of the ladies held my hand whilst I had the work done and it meant a lot to me as I haven't been to the dentist since I was incredibly young. That made me feel so at ease.
The results are amazing, I feel like a new person, definitely was some happy tears and would happily recommend this place to anyone.
The only thing I do regret was not being in the physical state to give an after photo due to the sensitivity in my mouth after everything but after a few hours it has completely subsided.
Thank you so much to Dr Sunil, the dentist who worked on my teeth, the nurses and the whole team :)

Will definitely see me again next year

- Yianoulla Williams
